messages:
maya: heads-up: I'm starting the readiness review for the ap-south1 GPU cluster bring-up. Posting the lightweight gate checklist here so we can run through and sign off. @jason @anika pls coordinate on networking and capacity.

jason: ack. i'll validate peering, subnet sizes, and route tables. will run connectivity smoke tests after the nodes join.

anika: i'll run the GPU driver + runtime checks and the initial benchmark traces. putting together the quick commands now.

maya: checklist (high level):
• Control plane: API reachability, kube-apiserver p95 < 200ms
• Node readiness: >= 95% nodes Ready after join within 10m
• GPU health: nvidia-smi OK on all GPUs; no ECC errors
• Pod networking: cross-az pod->pod latency < 3ms internal, DNS resolution < 50ms
• Scheduling: batch queue can schedule 10 sample jobs without CPU/GPU contention
• SLO gates: request failure rate < 0.5% over 15m, p95 inference latency < 150ms for sample model
• Cost sanity: instance shapes match billing SKUs, expected hourly burn within 10% of estimate
• Observability: metrics export working to prometheus endpoint and traces appear in jaeger

liam: adding infra-bot checks:
• infra-bot: cluster_autoscaler status OK
• infra-bot: k8s_events error_count < 5 in last 30m

anika: GPU smoke commands:
```
# on a sample node
ssh ubuntu@node-01
watch -n 2 nvidia-smi
docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.2-base nvidia-smi
# quick perf: run a small model on tensorbench
python -m tensorbench.run --model tiny --batch 1 --steps 50
```
I'll paste driver/version outputs to the thread.

jason: networking quick tests:
```
# from control plane
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl exec -it test-pod -- ping -c 5 <node-ip>
# check routes
ip route show | grep <cluster-cidr>
```
Ran across one route conflict earlier; i've already opened the route fix PR.

maya: SLO gating rules for handoff (must pass all to proceed):
1) API p95 < 200ms over 15m
2) Node Ready >= 95% within 10m of join
3) GPU fatal error rate == 0 over 1h
4) Sample model p95 < 150ms and success rate >= 99.5%
5) No critical k8s events in last 30m
6) Observability metrics and logs present in console (last ingestion < 2m)

anika: pasted GPU outputs: 
"Driver Version: 535.54.03" 
"CUDA Version: 11.8" 
nvidia-smi shows all 8 GPUs healthy on node-01. ran tensorbench: p95=72ms, success=100%

jason: control-plane checks: apiserver p95=120ms, etcd quorum healthy, 3/3 masters Ready. pod-network cross-node pings avg 1.8ms. route PR merged.

maya: cost check: initial estimator predicted $6.8/hr for the nodepool; actual observed from billing-metering is $7.1/hr — within 5% so OK.

liam: infra-bot: cluster_autoscaler status: OK; scaled to 2 extra nodes during scheduling test and scaled down cleanly.

maya: outstanding items before handoff: 
- confirm load test for 1k concurrent small inferences (anika)
- run evict/rook resilience test (jason)
- schedule readiness review meeting with infra-sre next hour

anika: kicking off 1k concurrent test now. will post summary in 20m.

jason: starting eviction test, simulating node drain on one GPU node.

maya: if both pass, i'll mark cluster as READY and file the handoff ticket to platform-owner. sign-off required from @jason and @anika.

anika: 1k run done: p95=148ms, failures=0.8% (6/750). investigation: two timeouts from a single noisy node; suspect NIC driver hiccup.

jason: eviction test: pods rescheduled within expected window, PVCs reattached, no crashloop. NIC logs show a transient driver reset; i'm triaging.

maya: decision: since SLO p95 <150ms was marginal (148ms) and failure rate 0.8% > target, we hold handoff until we root-cause the NIC reset. Noting mitigation: cordon noisy node and re-image.

liam: infra-bot: created incident placeholder INC-2026-004 for NIC noisy node, assigned to jason.

jason: reimaging node now, will run the 1k test again after.

anika: thanks — keep this thread updated. once reimage passes, i'll re-run tensorbench and the 1k test.

maya: thanks team — good run. Will update the handoff ticket after final pass. :white_check_mark:
